findings.finding_text: deliverRunKey mgrun- barrier is prefix-only — crafted keyMaterial (mgrun-\nEVIL_VAR=…) injects env entries into the delivered box file; charset-check base64url at the same choke point.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Merged blind-HIGH + edge-MED; the AC6 barrier must fail closed on content, not just prefix.

findings.finding_text: requireAdmin fail-opens to self-comparison when deps.env is unwired — hand-built MemgateDeps self-authorizes every admin op; the gate is structurally advisory on the default path.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Keep the registered rev-3(e) embedded seam but make it explicit: only memgateDeps (with no env) grants embedded mode via a flag; hand-built deps without env fail closed; env-wired deps compare presented-vs-configured as before.

findings.finding_text: deliver-state-write-failed strands a live key whose only revoke handle is a log line — the thrown error carries no tokenId, so a retrying caller mints a second live key.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Attach tokenId to the thrown MemgateError (extra readonly field) so the caller holds the compensation handle; credentials keeps keyHash on record analog.

findings.finding_text: Verifier TTL-backstop arm swallows any error class (bare catch) — false-green branch gate when the backstop breaks for the wrong reason.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Merged blind+edge: assert MemgateError with code mint-invalid-ttl.

findings.finding_text: Retain ceiling bypasses non-string content — typeof string check means a 50MB object/array forwards under a retain-verbs token.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Non-string content refuses forward-body-invalid (cap measured only on strings today).

findings.finding_text: Invalid limit silently coerced to undefined — the exact silent-widening the sibling query arm refuses; docstring promises violations throw.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Merged blind+edge: out-of-range/non-integer limit throws the same typed forward-body refusal.

findings.finding_text: Non-finite injected clock (NaN/Infinity) bypasses the expiry arm at verify AND forwardScoped — NaN never satisfies >=, Infinity yields ttlRemainingMs -Infinity in the log line.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: F-018 guarded mint only; verify/forward treat non-finite now as fail-closed expired refusal with ttlRemainingMs absent.

findings.finding_text: Verifier refusal arms assert only !r.ok, never the typed reason — a regression collapsing scope-bank into no-auth keeps the gate green.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Pin the expected reason per arm.

findings.finding_text: recordIssuance mislabels a UNIQUE collision as ledger-unwritable (recordRevocation maps the same race to already-gone).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: UNIQUE catch → typed token-id-collision error with correct remediation.

findings.finding_text: grantAgentToken accepts a born-expired expiresAtMs — dead-on-arrival issuance row persisted; docstring promises 'future'.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Merged blind+edge: grant-time comparison against now, typed refusal.

findings.finding_text: Writable-ledger F-021 cleanup is check-then-act — a failed open can rm a concurrent writer's populated ledger (busy_timeout anticipates multi-process).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Merged blind+edge: rm only when this constructor created the file AND it is still a zero-row skeleton.

findings.finding_text: assertExclusiveCreateSupported leaks the probe fd on the O_EXCL-not-honored refusal path.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Close the second fd before throwing.

findings.finding_text: Corrupt claims_json (non-object) classified ledger-unreadable with no tokenId — bypasses the D3/F-013 unknown-key ladder; two corruption classes split across paths.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Data-integrity faults ride the D3 ladder: no-auth + authOutcome unknown-key with tokenId on the line; ledger-unreadable reserved for storage faults.

findings.finding_text: forwardScoped client-missing / forward-body-invalid / ledger-unreadable-recheck arms emit no memgate-* line — request vanishes from the audit trail.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Best-effort plain-line emits on those arms (fail-closed already; observability gap only).

findings.finding_text: revokeRunMemoryKey hardcodes runId undefined — revoke/verify-revoked lines for run keys lose the correlation key.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Thread the issuance row's run_id through.

findings.finding_text: listAgentTokens reports claims.tokenId over the authoritative row.token_id PK — divergent rows list a handle that revokes as none.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Prefer the row PK.

findings.finding_text: mint/grant accept unbounded banks arrays — multi-MB claims blobs persist append-only and tax every verify parse.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: banks max 64 (verbs already bounded by the closed 4-vocabulary).

findings.finding_text: gateway.test deps() leaks one sqlite connection per call — no close anywhere in the file.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: afterEach closes tracked ledgers (test hygiene; EMFILE guard for CI).

findings.finding_text: Dir-mode refusal rewrapped: the crafted env-file-invalid error is swallowed by deliverRunKey's catch and rethrown as delivery-failed — taxonomy loss only.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Hoist the config assert out of the rewrap try.

findings.finding_text: 10 round-1 fixes lack named regression pins (F-004 forward TOCTOU, F-009 env ledger path, F-011 UNIQUE race, F-012 post-attach swap, F-020 raw-error wrap, F-021 cleanup, F-023 body validation, F-024 transport event, F-025 name/default-target, plus R2 fixes once landed).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Drift-guard gap, not a conformance defect — test wave adds honest pins for the testable subset.

findings.finding_text: Story Dev Agent Record line counts stale post-fix (340/375/497/72 vs on-disk 499/396/494/72).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Update at wave close (post-round-2-fix numbers).
